question: What kind of file has the extension .png?
solution:
The correct answer is an __**Image file**__.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__** 

__
 
• ** The various types of extensions of image files are:**

 
 
• JPEG (or JPG) - Joint Photographic Experts Group
 
• PNG - Portable Network Graphics
 
• GIF - Graphics Interchange Format
 
• TIFF - Tagged Image File
 
• PSD - Photoshop Document
 
• PDF - Portable Document Format
 
• EPS - Encapsulated Postscript
 
• AI - Adobe Illustrator Document
 
• INDD - Adobe Indesign Document
 
• RAW - Raw Image Formats.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Extensions of video files** are MP4, WMV, FLV, F4V, and SWF, and MPEG-2.
 
• **Extensions of document files** are .doc, .docm, .docx, .dot, .htm, .HTML, .mht; .mhtml, .pdf, .txt, .wps, .XML and .xps.
 
• **Extensions of audio files are **.3gp,** **.m4a, .m4b, .m4p, .mp3, .msv, .vox, .wma and .webm.
